name: day-14-env-config-validator
description: Base TypeScript local para el validador de configuración del día 14.

scripts.format: prettier --write package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json README.md ROADMAP.md docs/*.md assets/*.md src/**/*.ts tests/**/*.mjs data/**/*.json data/**/*.env --ignore-unknown
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json README.md ROADMAP.md docs/*.md assets/*.md src/**/*.ts tests/**/*.mjs data/**/*.json data/**/*.env --ignore-unknown
scripts.quality: npm run typecheck && npm run format:check
